watches.name: Knowledgraph
watches.description: What if a watch measured more than time Mechanical watches were created to measure time. Knowledgegraph is being created to make us more aware of how we use it. A mechanical watch concept by Amaux Bozé exploring the intersection of horology, knowledge and self-awareness . Instead of adding complications simply to measure more, Knowledgegraph asks a different question: What is worth measuring? A rotating timing scale turns the familiar language of a diver into a tool for intentional focus — 25 minutes of deep work, followed by time to step away. Where a conventional watch displays the date, Knowledgegraph explores something more personal: changing prompts, questions and habits that invite a brief moment of reflection throughout the week or month. And across the dial, nodes and connections reference the structure that gives the collection its name: the Knowledge Graph — a system in which isolated information becomes meaningful through its relationships. Technology inspires its visual language. Self-awareness gives it purpose. Mechanical watchmaking makes it tangible. Knowledgegraph is not about tracking everything. It is about noticing what matters. KNOWLEDGEGRAPH Mechanics for a brighter mind. A new mechanical watch concept by Amaux Bozé . Currently in development.

watches.name: Prestige Dress Watch
watches.description: The Prestige watch is a refined blend of elegance and craftsmanship, ideal for any occasion. Featuring a black sunburst dial with silver-tone markers and a date window, it delivers a clean, sophisticated look. The polished stainless steel case houses the SEIKO NH35 movement, visible through a transparent back. Paired with a black leather crocodile-embossed strap, this watch offers timeless style and reliable functionality, elevating any outfit.

specsRaw.Versatile: Timeless design, adaptable for any occasion or style.
specsRaw.Affordable: Enjoy craftmanship at an affordable price.
specsRaw.Direct Sourcing: We source directly from top manufacturers in China, known for producing the popular SEIKO movements NH34, NH35, and NH36, as well as high-quality watch components. Most watch brand do the same.
specsRaw.Low Margins: As a micro brand, we maintain low margins to keep prices down.
specsRaw.Passion Over Profit: Our focus is on creating stylish, affordable watches rather than large marketing campaigns or high earnings. Our mission is driven by a passion for watches and style, not profit.
specsRaw.Trusted Movements: We use well-established mechanical movements from the renowned SEIKO brand, specifically the widely adopted NH34, NH35, and NH36 movements, known for their reliability and precision.
specsRaw.Industry-Standard Components: Our watches incorporate components that are used by many top watch brands, ensuring the same high quality.
specsRaw.Swiss Assembly: Our watches are meticulously assembled in Switzerland, where our attention to detail ensures each watch meets the highest standards of craftsmanship and durability.

watches.name: Turbinant Diver
watches.description: Dive into the extraordinary with the Turbinant Diver Watch, a timepiece that marries maritime adventure with mechanical artistry. This full-skeleton masterpiece unveils its intricate soul through a bold pentagon-styled aperture, creating a mesmerizing turbine-like effect that captivates the eye and stirs the imagination. Engineered to withstand the pressures of the deep yet designed to elevate any ensemble, the Turbinant Diver is more than a watch—it's a statement of precision, passion, and the relentless pursuit of excellence. Whether exploring ocean depths or navigating life's daily challenges, this extraordinary timepiece serves as a constant reminder to dive deeper, push further, and savor every precious moment of your unique journey.

watches.name: Chatoyant Field Watch
watches.description: The Chatoyant field watch is a perfect blend of craftsmanship and vintage-inspired design, crafted for men who appreciate quality and timeless style. Its sleek black dial, bold white Arabic numerals, and polished leaf-shaped hands ensure easy readability while adding sophistication to any look. Built to be versatile and durable, this watch seamlessly complements both formal and casual outfits, making it more than just a timepiece—it’s a statement of refined taste and enduring style, all without the luxury price tag.

watches.name: Trenchborn Ronin
watches.description: The Trenchborn Ronin is a mechanical watch for men who like their style personal, grounded, and a little less obvious. It has presence, but not peacocking. Character, but not noise. It belongs to the same Trenchborn family: watches designed to feel distinctive on the wrist while still fitting a real life. Something you wear because it feels like you, not because it performs status for you. Powered by a dependable Seiko automatic movement, the Ronin brings together mechanical substance, masculine character, and everyday wearability.

watches.name: Khaybar Aqua
watches.description: Inspired by sun, water, and the freedom of summer days, the Khaybar Aqua brings a lighter side to mechanical watchmaking. The textured aqua-blue dial reflects the movement of waves, while the yellow seconds hand adds a subtle spark of energy. Paired with a yellow sailcloth strap, it feels fresh, relaxed, and ready for weekends and holidays. Switch to brown leather for a more grounded, everyday look—or a Milanese mesh for a cleaner, more refined presence. One watch. Different moods. Built for real life.

watches.name: Trenchborn Jaeger
watches.description: The Trenchborn Jaeger takes the same values-first spirit and gives it a different mood on the wrist. Distinctive, masculine, and properly made, it is built for men who want expression without noise and character without status theatre. Like the rest of the Trenchborn line, it is designed to be worn in real life — with taste, confidence, and no need to prove anything to strangers. The details do the talking quietly. Powered by a dependable Seiko automatic movement, the Jaeger is a mechanical watch with presence, personality, and a clear point of view.

watches.name: Trenchborn Intrepide
watches.description: The Trenchborn Intrepide is for men who want a watch with real personality, but no need for theatre. Its full-lume dial, wave-inspired artwork, and 40mm stainless steel case give it a bold presence that still feels wearable in real life. This is not a watch for status hunting. It is a watch for character — something distinctive enough to be interesting, but grounded enough to live with day after day. It sharpens an outfit, starts the right kind of conversation, and never feels like costume jewellery for grown men. Powered by a dependable Seiko automatic movement, the Intrepide brings together mechanical charm, playful confidence, and honest design.

watches.name: Khaybar Antarctica
watches.description: The Khaybar Antarctica is for men who like their watches crisp, restrained, and quietly distinctive. The cool dial tone, Persian dagger-shaped hands, and polished 40mm case give it a calm presence that feels refined without slipping into stiffness. With the black alligator-pattern leather strap, this version leans dressier and more formal, but it still carries the same values-first attitude: tasteful, wearable, and free of status theatre. Powered by a dependable Seiko automatic movement, it is a watch built for real life, real style, and men who know what matters.

watches.name: Khaybar Desert Dune
watches.description: The Khaybar Desert Dune is a dress watch for men who value character over display. Its textured dune dial, Persian dagger-shaped hands, and polished 40mm case give it quiet presence without turning it into theatre. This is the kind of watch that works the way good style should work: composed, distinctive, and easy to live with. Refined enough for dinner, relaxed enough for everyday wear, and built for men who care more about substance than status hunting. Inside is a dependable Seiko automatic movement. On the wrist, it feels thoughtful, masculine, and properly made.
